cases.title: Navigate workspace and create supported file types
cases.objective: Verify primary workspace navigation and entry points for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and designs.
preconditions: User is on the home workspace.
steps: Open workspace navigation views and utility controls.
Open the create dialog for each supported file type.
Return home and close the create dialog.
cases.expected_result: Each navigation view and create option is available, opens successfully, and returns to the home workspace.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Edit and format document content
cases.objective: Verify common document editing, formatting, sharing, and menu workflows.
preconditions: A new document can be opened.
steps: Open a document and enter text.
Apply text formatting, alignment, spacing, lists, indentation, styles, font, and font size.
cases.expected_result: Document content accepts the editing actions, formatting controls respond, sharing opens and closes, and menus are available.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Enter spreadsheet values and calculate a formula
cases.objective: Verify spreadsheet creation, cell editing, formula evaluation, long text entry, and return navigation.
preconditions: A spreadsheet can be created from the home workspace.
steps: Enter values in multiple cells and verify them.
Enter a formula and verify the calculated value.
Enter a long value and return to the home workspace.
cases.expected_result: Cell values persist after entry, the formula evaluates to 4, long text is accepted, and navigation returns home.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Create and edit a presentation with image insertion
cases.objective: Verify presentation creation, slide editing, slide deletion, and image insertion dialog behavior.
steps: Add slides and delete one slide from its context menu.
Open image insertion and submit an image address.
cases.expected_result: Presentation content can be edited, slides can be added and deleted, and the image insertion workflow accepts the address.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Use design themes, pages, elements, and text tools
cases.objective: Verify design canvas themes, backgrounds, pages, asset tabs, shapes, and text controls are usable.
preconditions: A design canvas can be created.
steps: Add pages and browse design, photo, element, and text controls.
Add shapes and text tools, then return home.
cases.expected_result: Design controls open and apply selections, pages can be added, and the user can return to the home workspace.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Reject invalid or empty document input
cases.objective: Verify empty submissions and invalid formatting input produce a clear, recoverable response.
cases.expected_result: Invalid input is rejected or safely handled without data loss, with an understandable user response.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Handle spreadsheet boundaries and invalid formulas
cases.objective: Verify empty cells, invalid formulas, boundary coordinates, duplicate edits, and rapid interaction.
cases.expected_result: The spreadsheet remains responsive and reports invalid operations without corrupting valid data.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Preserve spreadsheet data after refresh
cases.objective: Verify saved spreadsheet values and formulas remain available after refresh or a repeated open workflow.
steps: Compare values and formulas with the saved state.
cases.expected_result: Previously saved content is restored accurately after refresh and reopen.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.

cases.title: Use NativeOffice on a mobile viewport
cases.objective: Verify key navigation and creation workflows remain usable on a narrow mobile viewport.
steps: Open the home workspace on mobile.
Navigate and open the create workflow.
cases.expected_result: Primary controls remain visible, usable, and free of blocking overlap on mobile.
cases.supporting_evidence: Failure screenshot and Playwright trace when execution fails.
